name: Santa's Bedroom
source:
This story revolves around two older workshop elves getting into trouble in Santa's house.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211010125238/https://newwestgames.itch.io/short-series-santa]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事圍繞兩名在工坊工作的年長精靈展開，她們在聖誕老人的房子裡惹上了麻煩。

[來源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211010125238/https://newwestgames.itch.io/short-series-santa]Itch.io[/url]]
